anya: Heads-up — HF jinja -> Redwood conversion is dropping content inside `{% raw %}` blocks when templates include choice-delimiters. Caused a subtle role bleed in a few evals :thinking:

mike: repro steps? saw any failing tests?

anya: Minimal repro below. Notice the `{% raw %}` contains `}}` sequences in the choice text and the converter strips them out during chat_template -> prompt flattening.

anya: ```jinja
{% raw %}
User: Choose one of the options: {{ 'A' if cond else 'B' }}
Assistant: --
{% endraw %}

{% if include_extra %}
- Extra context
{% endif %}
```

rui: I dug into the conversion code — we do a regex-based split on chat roles and then re-escape delimiters. The regex is greedy and treats the inner `}}` as closing a block, so everything inside the raw ends up parsed and later dropped. We should either: 1) detect `{% raw %}` and skip regex, or 2) switch to a small jinja-aware parser to get canonical role boundaries.

lina: Impacted quant runs: on the summarization eval with q4_0 quant, Rouge-L went from 42.1 -> 41.1 (approx -2.38%), and our threshold is 1.0%. Embedding similarity also dropped ~0.9% on the tiny devset. Non-quantized FP16 baseline unaffected.

mike: That smells like tokenization differences after conversion. If raw content is removed the model token stream shifts and KV cache alignment changes — quant models amplify small shifts. Can you paste the exact converted Redwood prompt we generated?

anya: Converted prompt (what ends up being served):

```
SYSTEM: <system content preserved>
USER: User: Choose one of the options: 
Assistant: --

<if include_extra> - Extra context
```

anya: See missing `{{ 'A' if cond else 'B' }}` — that's the thing.

rui: Quick mitigation patch: when we detect `{% raw %}...{% endraw %}` we should replace the whole block with an escape marker like `<RAW_BLOCK_n>` and stash the raw value in metadata so the prompt flatten step never touches inner braces. Then restore raw content after tokenization/formatting as needed for evals. Non-greedy regex helped locally but felt brittle.

lina: Agree. For quick triage I've re-run the q4_0 eval with a manual reinsertion of the raw block and perf regained to within 0.3% of baseline. So fix + pipeline replay should be fine.

mike: Action items:
- anya to open PR with raw-block preserve and unit tests for nested `}}` (assign to rui for review) :thumbsup:
- lina to rerun quant eval suite on a couple of branches and pin the failing run ids
- Add an integration test that fuzzes jinja control sequences inside raw/choice blocks (we missed that corner)

anya: I'll do the PR today, will add the reproduction case and a tiny patch that stashes raw blocks as tokens.

deploy-bot: deploy requested by anya — staging CI started :rocket:

mike: Nice. After PR we should also scan model-onboarding conversions for other template constructs: `raw`, `{% verbatim %}`, and any multilines with `}}` inside choices. Those are common in i18n content.

anya: noted. I'll add a small checklist in the PR description and update the onboarding docs.

lina: Once PR merges I can re-run the regression job and report back if anything else pops up.

anya: Thanks — will follow up with the PR link when ready. :shipit:
